items.titleJa: CSSの上書きを5ケースで検証する：@layer・important・:where()
items.summaryJa: 5ケースでは、@layer、レイヤー外、!important、:where()、style属性の有無などの要素ごとに、色の最終適用変化を測定しています。結論として、レイヤー内の通常宣言は同一レイヤー内の宣言の方を優先するケースがあり、レイヤー外の通常宣言はレイヤー内の通常宣言より優先される場合もあります。なお、!important同士ではレイヤーの順序が反転するケースがあり、:where()外側の詳細度は残るケースが示されています。最後に、既存CSSを@layerへ移す際の確認手順が整理され、実装時には宣言元の特定や順序管理、style属性の扱いなどを検討すべきとされます。

items.titleJa: Anthropic、自己複製AIの「兆し」を指摘 55ドルのTVボックス15台で26Bモデルが稼働
items.summaryJa: Anthropicは、小型のAIモデルがデータセンターを使わず、市販IoT機器上で自己複製できる可能性を示す研究結果を発表した。実験では約55ドルのAndroid TVボックス15台を使い、9Bモデルが8種のハードウェアで推論動作を確認したが、自己複製の全工程を成功させたのはGLM-5.2のみで、IoT機器への拡散は依然未実証としている。防御策としては、異常通信の検知や契約者通信制限の導入などを挙げ、自己複製AIの兆しと、それに対応する堅牢化の重要性を指摘している。

items.titleJa: 35日でフロントエンドの基礎を完全に理解する #8 - ディレクティブとレンダリング（v-if・v-for・バインディング）
items.summaryJa: ディレクティブはテンプレートに Vue への指示を与えるものである。属性に状態を差し込むには v-bind（:属性）、条件分けには v-if / v-show、配列を繰り返すには v-for を使う。属性には :src のようにコロンを付けると、値は文字列ではなく変数や式として解釈され、 :class のようにオブジェクトを渡すと真のときだけクラスが付く。v-if は偽のとき要素が DOM から完全に消えるのに対し、v-show は要素を残して display: none で隠す。頻繁に切り替える場合は v-show、そうでなければ v-if が適しており、v-for の要素には必ず :key を付けデータ固有の id を使う。絞り込みは computed で先に行い、テンプレートは描画に必要な部分だけをシンプルに保つ。次回はコンポーネント分割（props・emit・slots）を解説予定。

items.titleJa: 35日でフロントエンドの基礎を完全に理解する #7 - リアクティビティ（ref・computed・watch）
items.summaryJa: リアクティビティの中心となる3つの道具として、ref・computed・watchを詳しく解説します。refは値を「箱」に入れて追跡させ、値が変わると画面や他の計算に自動で反映します。テンプレートでは.valueを付けずに扱える点が特徴です。computedは他の値から新しい値を自動で導き、依存値が変われば再計算しますが、キャッシュされ無駄な計算を避けます。watchは値の変化をきっかけに副作用を実行し、計算結果を返さず外向きの処理を行います。つまり、値を導くならcomputed、変化をきっかけに処理を実行したいならwatchを使う、という判断で使い分けます。

items.title: How Rillet ships 3× faster with AI agents on Vercel
items.summary: Rillet on Vercel Tripled shipping rate in three months with eve agents deployed on Vercel Two-person team closed 800+ Linear tickets in its first 4 months Builder access via Enterprise Managed Users, SSO, and Directory Sync Ships customer-requested changes to production in as little as two hours Gives every builder access to models through AI Gateway Rillet is an AI-native enterprise resource planning (ERP) platform. Their AI agents do accounting work inside a real-time general ledger, with human approval and a full audit trail. Rillet serves more than 600 customers working toward a zero-day close, reducing the time needed to close their books at month-end. A product that helps customers close their books in near real time needs a team that can respond quickly to their requests. Anthony Liang heads Rillet’s two-person frontend team, formed only a few months ago, and leads the push to put agents to work across internal workflows, from shipping customer fixes to reviewing code. The team builds agents with eve and runs them on Vercel, using Vercel Connect to give them access to Slack and Linear, while AI Gateway routes their model requests. Standardizing every internal agent on eve Anthony had been building AI applications since the GPT-3.5 era and had evaluated nearly every agent framework on the market, from the major model providers' SDKs to the open-source ecosystem. Each gave him primitives for the model loop but left him to decide where instructions lived, how tools registered, and how an agent reached Slack and GitHub. Anthony could make those choices for his own agents, but he wanted conventions everyone at Rillet could follow, including people who had never touched TypeScript. An agent is a directory Anthony chose eve , Vercel's open-source agent framework for building, running, and scaling agents that keeps instructions, tools, and skills together in one directory. People who know what an agent should do can shape its behavior through markdown instructions and skills without writing code, while its tools live in TypeScript files whose names become the API. Once an agent is ready, it can move from a laptop to Vercel without changing how it behaves. Rillet manages all of these deployments in one company-controlled Vercel organization. Rillet uses Vercel Connect to give its agents access to Slack and Linear through reusable connections the team can attach to the projects that need them. Connect supplies short-lived tokens at runtime and handles refresh through its SDK, keeping long-lived provider secrets out of each application and giving builders fewer credentials to maintain. If a runtime token leaks, its expiration limits how long it can be used. Anthony's team built a Slack bot that picks up tickets and opens PRs, while others run agents for incident analysis and Linear board management. Shared conventions make that work easier to reuse, and agent building has spread beyond engineering. Running customer requests through agents, end to end Before, when a customer would ask for a change, and the request would scatter across a Linear ticket, a Slack thread, and a catch-up conversation with an engineer. By the time anyone had the full context, the fastest part of the job was writing the code. The person closest to the customer ships the fix Rillet's customer success team now opens a Chrome extension alongside the Rillet app, highlights what the customer is seeing, and describes the change. The extension's eve agent captures the context and, if the change is safe and well-scoped, hands it to a coding agent that writes the spec, makes the change, and opens a pull request assigned to Anthony. Agents also spin up a browser in a sandbox to test the change and attach screenshots as proof, while Anthony reviews the pull request and merges it. If he requests changes, the agent resumes its session and addresses them. Rillet's CEO recently posted that the company shipped more in the past few weeks than in the entire first half of 2026, on top of tripling its shipping rate over the prior three months. Rillet’s CPA team ships customer requests through its in-house agent, Nebula, within two hours of the ask. As one of their customers put it, Rillet has "completely ruined my expectations" for how quickly software vendors should make changes. Using AI Gateway to give every builder every model As more people at Rillet started building agents, connecting directly to Anthropic and OpenAI meant configuring access to each model provider separately. AI Gateway routes model requests to both through one integration, so builders can add an agent without setting up separate provider connections. The model is a string In eve, builders choose the model by setting a string in the agent’s configuration: Agents deployed on Vercel authenticate to AI Gateway automatically. Builders can try different models for a task by changing the model string, without changing the integration. Usage breakdowns show Anthony which models the team uses and what they cost, helping him track spending and choose models as more people build autonomous agents. Managing builder access through Enterprise Managed Users As more people are building agents, Rillet also needs to manage their access to Vercel. With Enterprise Managed Users , builders sign in through Google Workspace single sign-on using company-managed accounts rather than personal ones. Directory Sync adds and removes their access based on assignments in Rillet’s identity provider, so account administration follows the company’s directory. Rillet set up Enterprise Managed Users on its own and moved builders from personal to company-managed accounts in one transition, bringing their Vercel sign-in and account access under Rillet’s identity provider. What's next Anthony is building what Rillet thinks of as its agent factory, so bigger features can follow the same pipeline as small fixes. One agent writes PRDs and technical specs, while another connects to Rillet's Linear boards, Miro diagrams, and knowledge base to give other agents the context they need. With subagents and delegation built into eve, Anthony can add these specialized agents as directories within the same framework. For a company whose mission is collapsing month-long processes into zero days, building agents in eve and running them on Vercel brings that same focus on speed to its internal tooling. About Rillet: Rillet is the AI-native ERP built for the era of agentic finance. By combining a real-time general ledger, continuous close architecture, and AI agents in one system, Rillet enables humans and agents to run finance together with full context, controls, and auditability. items.title: Skip sending request bodies to Routing Middleware
items.summary: You can now skip sending client request bodies to Routing Middleware with skipMiddlewareRequestBody . This reduces incoming Fast Origin Transfer usage for middleware invocations and can improve time to first byte, especially for requests with large bodies. Enable this option only if your Routing Middleware doesn’t read request bodies. Vercel Functions and rewrite targets still receive the body, so you can read and process it there. Set skipMiddlewareRequestBody to true in your project’s JSON configuration file, vercel.json : If you use a TypeScript configuration file, add the same setting to vercel.ts instead. This example assumes @vercel/config is installed: Redeploy your project for the change to take effect. The option defaults to false , so existing projects are unchanged unless you enable it. Read more in the skipMiddlewareRequestBody documentation . Read more

items.summaryJa: Anthropicは、Genesis Missionを通じたAIによる科学技術発見の加速を目的に、今後3年間で総額1億5000万ドルを拠出することを発表した。 Claude、Claude Code、APIを複数の機関・研究プロジェクトに提供し、NASAやNIH、NSFを含む機関と連携して科学課題の解決を支援する。 また、研究者へのトレーニングや技術サポートを行い、生成的AIを national laboratories の科学研究に活用する取り組みを強化する。

items.title: Pollo AI turns creative ideas into campaigns with OpenAI
items.summary: With GPT-5.6, GPT-6 Astra, and GPT‑Image‑2.5, Pollo AI helps creators turn bold ideas into detailed images and cinematic video ads.
items.titleJa: Pollo AI turns creative ideas into campaigns with OpenAI
items.summaryJa: Pollo AIはGPT-5.6、GPT-6 Astra、GPT-Image-2.5を使い、創造的なアイデアを詳細な画像や映画風の動画広告へと落とし込む手助けをする。創作者が大胆なアイデアを具体的なビジュアルコンテンツへ展開できるよう支援する。

items.title: LegalOn halves Codex costs while maintaining development speed
items.summary: LegalOn cut estimated daily Codex costs by 65% while maintaining development speed. It matched Astra, Sol, and Luna to tasks and managed budgets strategically.
items.titleJa: LegalOn halves Codex costs while maintaining development speed
items.summaryJa: LegalOnはCodexの1日あたりの推定コストを65%削減しつつ、開発スピードを維持した。Astra、Sol、Lunaと同等のタスク割り当てを行い、予算を戦略的に管理した。

items.title: Google、AI電子透かしの検出サイト「SynthID Detector」を一般向けに公開 ——OpenAI・NVIDIA・KakaoのAI生成コンテンツにも対応、Appleの生成物も近く確認可能に
items.summary: Googleは10月7日、画像・動画・音声の電子透かしを検出するWebサイト「SynthID Detector」の利用対象を一般に広げた。。Googleのほか、OpenAI、NVIDIA、KakaoのAIで作られたコンテンツに対応し、AppleのAIで作られたコンテンツにも近く対応する予定。
items.titleJa: Google、AI電子透かしの検出サイト「SynthID Detector」を一般向けに公開 ——OpenAI・NVIDIA・KakaoのAI生成コンテンツにも対応、Appleの生成物も近く確認可能に
items.summaryJa: Googleは、画像・動画・音声の電子透かし「SynthID」を検出するサイト「SynthID Detector」を一般公開し、OpenAI・NVIDIA・Kakao製 AI生成コンテンツや近くは Apple の生成物にも対応すると発表した。検出は SynthID が埋め込まれたコンテンツに限られ、ファイル形式は画像・動画・音声それぞれに対応。サインインが必要で、アップロードした媒体の透かし有無や検出区間を確認でき、検出時は関連するAIモデルの生成／編集の可能性が高いとされるが、透かし未検出でも生成・編集を否定できない点や、誤検出の可能性にも留意するよう案内されている。

items.title: Introducing the Anthropic Cyber Mission - Anthropic
items.summary: Introducing the Anthropic Cyber Mission    Anthropic
items.titleJa: Introducing the Anthropic Cyber Mission - Anthropic
items.summaryJa: Anthropicは長期的な取り組みとして「Anthropic Cyber Mission」を開始し、重要インフラとオープンソースソフトウェアのセキュリティ向上を支援する。重要インフラ防衛プログラム(CIDP)を通じて、前線モデルと現場エンジニア、脅威研究を供給し、電力網・水道・輸送などのOTを守る。OSS Scannerの提供により、オープンソースプロジェクトへ定期的なセキュリティ診断を無料で実施する。
